title: Spacecraft Attitude Dynamics Simulator — Overview and definition
t: Spacecraft Attitude Dynamics Simulator — Overview and definition
description: Simulates spacecraft orientation, wheels, thrusters, and control laws.
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Simulates spacecraft orientation, wheels, thrusters, and control laws. An attitude dynamics simulator propagates quaternion kinematics with reaction wheels, thrusters, magnetorquers, and flexible modes under gravity-gradient, aero, and solar torques. Real implementations include NASA 42, Basilisk, and GMAT attitude modules. It validates ADCS control laws and momentum management. Engineering use only. Capability specification and design target: this database describes what the tool must do, not a claim of implementation or deployment. Defensive and engineering content only — no weapon-targeting or attack-execution content.
